title: Upload a file
content: To upload a file, go to Upload page, click the button, select your file, and confirm.

title: Reset password
content: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page. Check your email for the reset code.

title: Update profile
content: To update your project, click on your avatar in the upper right corner of your screen. You can update your profile there.

title: Change password
content: To change your password, click on your avatar in the upper right corner of your screen, switch to the tab change password. Enter your old password, new password, confirm password and confirm.

title: Create project
content: To create a project, first you have to log in, then in sidebar on the left of your screen press project, then press the create new project , enter all the information and press create project.

title: Create public request
content: To create a public request, first you have to log in, then in sidebar on the left of your screen press My Request, then press Create New Request button, choose Public Request type,then enter all the field and the file you want to translate and press create request. We now only support json,txt,docx and pdf file type. Other will be update in the future.

title: Create private request
content: To create a private request, first you have to log in, then in sidebar on the left of your screen press My Request, then press Create New Request button, choose Private Request type,then choose the person you want to assign the request, then enter the other field and the file you want to translate and press create request. We now only support json,txt,docx and pdf file type. Other will be update in the future.
